correctness.rationale: Reconstructed ordinary (not total) k-cut complex with facets complements of disconnected k-sets, k≥3,N≥k+4 and girth≥k+2 (forests have infinite girth). Every (k+1)-set induces a forest; deleting a suitable vertex leaves a disconnected k-subset, establishing the full (N-k-2)-skeleton. The Alexander dual consists exactly of all faces of cardinality ≤k−1 plus top (k−1)-simplices indexed by connected k-sets. Each connected k-set is a tree; remove a degree≥2 vertex to get a disconnected (k−1)-set S. Any different connected S∪{z} must join two original components, producing a cycle inside k+1 vertices, forbidden. Thus each top simplex has its own private lower face, giving a diagonal ±1 minor and split injection of top boundary columns into integral cycles of the full (k−2)-skeleton. Consequently dual reduced cohomology is free in degree k−2 with rank binom(N−1,k−1)−c_k; Alexander duality gives the claimed sole nonzero integral homology of Δ in dimension d=N−k−1. Since its full (d−1)-skeleton with d≥3 makes it simply connected, Hurewicz then homology Whitehead identifies the wedge of d-spheres (including rank0 contractible). For k=4, every connected induced four-set is a P4 or 3-star by girth; unique middle edge or center gives exact degree formula. Independently enumerated C9 k4 connected sets 9 (47 spheres); two-/three-hex chains have c4=20/34, predicted 64S5 and 252S9, matching degree sums. Finite checks corroborate but are not the proof for all graphs.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for all-k (especially k≥4) homotopy classification under girth ≥k+2, distinct from Bayer et al. 2023 existing complete-skeleton and Euler-characteristic results. The decisive new assertion is top-dimensional integral homology concentration and consequent wedge without shellability, proved by a private codimension-one face for every connected k-set. The indexed three-cut high-girth published SCOPE statement is explicitly a k=3 special case, and does not imply the universal k≥4 assertion. Previously known forest, cycle and k=2 cases are credited, not treated as new.

value.rationale: Meaningful general natural structural theorem: removes the unresolved lower-degree homology allowed by the prior general face-lattice theorem and yields unconditional integral homotopy type on a broad class of high-girth graphs for every k≥3, without proving shellability. Explicit k4 degree-invariant formula covers any girth-six graph and precise hex-chain benchmarks. The private-face lemma is nonstandard and mathematically useful, not a routine rescaling of Euler characteristic.
